items.name: Show links on Place/Scene map
items.desc: Draws coupler links on the Assets and Scene maps. The Affects tab always shows them.

items.name: Characters (graph layer)
items.desc: Shows characters in the Affects graph.

items.name: Zones (graph layer)
items.desc: Shows zones in the Affects graph.

items.name: Settling trails
items.desc: Shows the trails nodes leave as the graph settles.

items.name: Settling trails
items.desc: Nodes are positioned by coupler links and by how alike their E/B/P/S profiles are — not by scene placement. Re-run if it looks tangled.

items.name: Saved paths (user)
items.desc: A saved path to preview over the graph.

items.name: From Agent
items.desc: The actor the link starts from.

items.name: To Agent
items.desc: The actor the link points to.

items.name: Strength
items.desc: How strongly the link couples the two actors, 0 to 1. Default 0.60.

items.name: R Resonance
items.desc: Coupler: aligns and amplifies the dimensions the two actors share.

items.name: G Gated
items.desc: Coupler: an inner coupler that acts only when a condition holds (for example S>0.5).

items.name: T Threshold
items.desc: Coupler: a nonlinear phase transition that triggers on a condition (for example E>0.7).

items.name: L Delay
items.desc: Coupler: a time-shifted response with a lag in ticks.
